sentences.en: Man, too, has been given protective devices against extreme temperatures.
sentences.zh: 人类也被赋予了抵御极端温度的保护装置。

sentences.en: Medical staff have been using garbage bags as protective gowns.
sentences.zh: 医护人员一直在用垃圾袋充当防护服使用。

sentences.en: Yanni's kids were taken away by the child protective services.
sentences.zh: 雅尼的孩子被儿童保护服务带走了。

senses.zh: 保护的, 防护的 - 显示保护意愿的
